findings.passage: SB 293 is about protecting the integrity of our elections while also making it easier and more accessible for eligible voters to participate.
findings.note: Release in her name on Senate Bill 293, which would require mailed absentee ballots to reach the board of elections by poll closing on Election Day. Passage reassembled from two fetch-tool lines of one quoted sentence. Same release also quotes her: "This bill reflects the hard work and collaboration needed to keep our electoral system secure, accessible, and trustworthy." and "It's a forward-looking approach that strengthens our system and builds confidence in our elections." Not about ID or citizenship.
